_comment: Castalia-Penta (CP2): the Castalia defaults plus a FIFTH hart -- hart 4, the always-on soft ORCHESTRATOR in the centre band. numHarts=5 grows the fabric through the existing single sources (arbiter/resv N=5+, MW 2->3, CLINT/irq_router/debug NHARTS=5, and the CLINT layout SHIFTS: mtime 0x5020, mtimecmp[0] 0x5030 -- derive CLINT addresses from NHARTS, never hardcode); managementHart=4 makes that hart an `orch_tile` wired hart-0-style for power/reset (no pwr_ctrl row, no iso clamps -- PWRCR keeps bits for tiles 1-3 only) and tile-style for boot/IRQ, and moves the AFE/EIS management privilege to it (afe_stub MGMT_HART=4, eis0 OWNER_HART=4; AFE0-3 keep OWNER_HART 0-3). The four corner tiles and everything else are untouched. Build with: make chip CONFIG=config/penta.json ; prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/penta.json
